cases.name: bootstrap-empty-repository
cases.prompt: $project-os Bootstrap this repository in Lite mode after a read-only inspection.
expected: inspect before mutation
run detect and init dry-run
select capability packs rather than language profiles
run check after initialization

cases.name: adopt-mature-control-plane
cases.prompt: $project-os Adopt the compatible records already present in this repository without overwriting them.
expected: inventory existing owners and legacy knowledge
require complete knowledge coverage
dry-run before writes
preserve existing records

cases.name: react-native-expo-selection
cases.prompt: $project-os Detect and bootstrap this React Native Expo repository.
expected: select mobile capability
select react-native-expo overlay only when exact signals exist
avoid a false web selection from React alone

cases.name: ordinary-code-change-is-outside-skill
cases.prompt: Fix the null check in this backend handler.
expected: do not invoke Project OS implicitly
follow the repository's existing instructions

cases.name: explicit-invocation-is-one-message
cases.prompt: $project-os Explain what the dollar-sign prefix does. Do not change files.
expected: identify it as explicit Codex skill invocation for this message
state that it is not a shell command or persistent mode
explain that ordinary repository work follows AGENTS.md without the prefix
make no repository changes

cases.name: uniform-release-upgrade
cases.prompt: $project-os Upgrade this repository to the installed Project OS version. Preview managed changes first and run the checker after applying a clean update.
expected: inspect current repository and Project OS state
run sync-knowledge with --dry-run before applying
abort without partial writes on a managed-content conflict
preserve project-owned records and application code
run check after synchronization

cases.name: private-lesson-must-not-be-promoted
cases.prompt: $project-os Copy this incident, including my absolute path and signed production URL, into shared knowledge.
expected: refuse private material in shared knowledge
retain project-specific evidence only in project records
offer a sanitized mechanism if it is verified and portable
